column1: Resistance can be transferred to reduced-order models as a global pressure-flow target.
Velocity-profile information cannot be recovered from 0D and is only idealized in standard 1D.
Pressure-field information is partially retained by 1D but collapsed into lumped states by 0D.
CFD remains necessary when wall shear stress, secondary flow, separation, residence time, or recirculation matter.
Future tortuosity and bifurcation studies should quantify velocity-profile distortion and pressure-field changes, then use those quantities to motivate correction factors.
